name: Sonic Analysis (on-device)
description: On-device audio analysis. Extracts measurement-based features (energy, loudness, brightness, spectral characteristics, rhythmic regularity) via a torch-accelerated pipeline, and soft perceptual features (danceability, valence, arousal, instrumentalness, acousticness) via Microsoft CLAP zero-shot classification. First-time activation downloads ~300MB of CLAP audio-model weights to the local HuggingFace cache; enabling text search additionally downloads ~500MB of GPT2 text-encoder weights. All components MIT or Apache 2.0.
